findings.body: The setting changes, but the promised routing does not work in this repository. forge.toml retains repo = "forge-source". src/forge/repo.py:424 recognizes user-facing tasks only when repo == "client"; src/forge/worker.py:73 uses that result, so even a User-facing: yes story task still selects Codex. tests/test_design_route.py:57–64 explicitly exercises this source-repository exception. The Claude design entry is correctly configured, but this change never selects it for this repository's user-facing story tasks. Address that routing gap while leaving the remaining forge.toml settings unchanged.

findings.body: tests/test_fix_the_owner_moved_this_repo_s_workers_from.py:35 reads this checkout's forge.toml and unconditionally asserts config["workers"] == "codex". Changing the setting to "split" makes that assertion fail. The test remains included in the pytest tests command configured here and in .github/workflows/forge.yml. Update the obsolete expectation while preserving its checks that ordinary work and reviews remain on Codex.
